sentences.hanzi: 九月十日是教师节。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔyuè shírì shì Jiàoshījié.
sentences.english: September tenth is Teacher's Day.

sentences.hanzi: 小明很想谢谢他的老师，因为老师每天认真地教他。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hěn xiǎng xièxie tā de lǎoshī, yīnwèi lǎoshī měitiān rènzhēn de jiāo tā.
sentences.english: Xiaoming really wanted to thank his teacher, because the teacher taught him earnestly every day.

sentences.hanzi: 小明想给老师写一张卡片，可是他写的字不太好看。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎng gěi lǎoshī xiě yī zhāng kǎpiàn, kěshì tā xiě de zì bù tài hǎokàn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming wanted to write a card for his teacher, but his handwriting was not very nice.

sentences.hanzi: 他写了三次，都不满意，心里很难过。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě le sān cì, dōu bù mǎnyì, xīnli hěn nánguò.
sentences.english: He wrote it three times, was not satisfied with any of them, and felt very sad.

sentences.hanzi: 小明对丽丽说："我想给老师写一张卡片，可是我的字写得不好看。怎么办呢？"
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng duì Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng gěi lǎoshī xiě yī zhāng kǎpiàn, kěshì wǒ de zì xiě de bù hǎokàn. Zěnme bàn ne?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said to Lili: "I want to write a card for my teacher, but my handwriting doesn't look nice. What should I do?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说："别着急！我可以帮你。你跟我一起练习，你的字会越写越好看的。"
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Bié zháojí! Wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ. Nǐ gēn wǒ yīqǐ liànxí, nǐ de zì huì yuè xiě yuè hǎokàn de."
sentences.english: Lili said: "Don't worry! I can help you. Practice with me, and your handwriting will get better and better."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽找来纸和笔，先写了一个字给小明看。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zhǎo lái zhǐ hé bǐ, xiān xiě le yī gè zì gěi Xiǎomíng kàn.
sentences.english: Lili found paper and a pen, and first wrote a character to show Xiaoming.

sentences.hanzi: 她说："写的时候要慢慢写，一笔一笔地写。"
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: "Xiě de shíhou yào mànmàn xiě, yī bǐ yī bǐ de xiě."
sentences.english: She said: "When you write, write slowly, stroke by stroke."

sentences.hanzi: 小明跟丽丽一起练习。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng gēn Lìlì yīqǐ liànxí.
sentences.english: Xiaoming practiced together with Lili.

sentences.hanzi: 第一天，他写了半个小时，手很累。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī tiān, tā xiě le bàn gè xiǎoshí, shǒu hěn lèi.
sentences.english: On the first day, he wrote for half an hour, and his hand was very tired.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，他写得更认真了。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān, tā xiě de gèng rènzhēn le.
sentences.english: On the second day, he wrote even more earnestly.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说："你的字比昨天好多了！"
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Nǐ de zì bǐ zuótiān hǎo duō le!"
sentences.english: Lili said: "Your handwriting is much better than yesterday!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明很高兴，他对丽丽说："谢谢你每天帮我练习。没有你的帮助，我写不出这么好看的字。"
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hěn gāoxìng, tā duì Lìlì shuō: "Xièxie nǐ měitiān bāng wǒ liànxí. Méiyǒu nǐ de bāngzhù, wǒ xiě bù chū zhème hǎokàn de zì."
sentences.english: Xiaoming was very happy. He said to Lili: "Thank you for helping me practice every day. Without your help, I couldn't write such nice characters."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽笑着说："不用谢。老师帮了我们那么多，我们也应该谢谢老师。"
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiào zhe shuō: "Bùyòng xiè. Lǎoshī bāng le wǒmen nàme duō, wǒmen yě yīnggāi xièxie lǎoshī."
sentences.english: Lili said with a smile: "You're welcome. The teacher has helped us so much; we should thank the teacher too."

sentences.hanzi: 九月十日那天早上，小明从花园里剪了一些漂亮的花。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔyuè shírì nà tiān zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng cóng huāyuán lǐ jiǎn le yīxiē piàoliang de huā.
sentences.english: On the morning of September tenth, Xiaoming cut some beautiful flowers from the garden.

sentences.hanzi: 他把花和自己做的卡片放在老师的桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ huā hé zìjǐ zuò de kǎpiàn fàng zài lǎoshī de zhuōzi shang.
sentences.english: He put the flowers and the card he had made on the teacher's desk.

sentences.hanzi: 老师看了卡片，又看了看花，眼睛有点红了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī kàn le kǎpiàn, yòu kàn le kàn huā, yǎnjing yǒudiǎn hóng le.
sentences.english: The teacher looked at the card, then looked at the flowers, and her eyes turned a little red.

sentences.hanzi: 她说："小明，谢谢你！这是老师收到的最好的礼物，你的字写得真好看！"
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: "Xiǎomíng, xièxie nǐ! Zhè shì lǎoshī shōudào de zuì hǎo de lǐwù, nǐ de zì xiě de zhēn hǎokàn!"
sentences.english: She said: "Xiaoming, thank you! This is the best gift I have ever received, and your handwriting is really beautiful!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明开心地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng kāixīn de xiào le.
sentences.english: Xiaoming smiled happily.

sentences.hanzi: 他觉得，用心做的事，就是最好的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde, yòngxīn zuò de shì, jiùshì zuì hǎo de lǐwù.
sentences.english: He felt that things done with heart are the best gifts of all.
